m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: That means you've secured the Chaos Heart as well! Great work, Understudy. I'd say that's deserving of an Arcanum promotion, eh, Ione?
Once all the appropriate paperwork has been reviewed and filed, perhaps. Until then, I will give my thanks, along with a heartfelt, 'Good work'.
Just doing our jobs, ma'am.
Really, this hero's welcome is far too much. But appreciated. You're all heroes in our eyes too. Ooo, did someone bring cake?
Doctor Beans! Pork. We are pleased you are not dead. However, I find your lack of Sparck... disturbing. Where is my brother?
Sparck is on Nimbus... helping your mother. But he asked me to give you this communicator we designed together. Here, let me show you how it works...
I'll figure it out on my own, thank you. As for you, Wizard. Your accomplishments in Empyrea will not go unrecognized-
Sakes alive! Was that...?
The Tree of Knowledge! Sybil only speaks if she has information that must be heard. The fact that she singled you out, Wizard, is... important.
We've no time for riddles, Tree. What are we supposed to be afraid of?
Well, that was... disconcerting. I fear your heroics in thwarting Raven and Spider may have unintentionally ushered in something much, much worse.
It will take some time for us to process this information, Wizard. Until then, do not stray far...
I was actually a little scared for a while there, but my friends had my back. I'm sorry I worried you. I love you so much, Mom!
You go take care of all that official business. I've got a daughter to dote upon.
